observations.summary: Test_Ohk_Python_Env_And_Doc_Refusal_Integration delegates directly to the three module-level test functions in the same file, executing each subprocess scenario twice per pytest run (~8.2s total).
_flatten_changed preserves internal spaces in filenames by splitting on splitlines(), though adding an explicit filename-with-spaces case to the unit assertion would document that invariant directly.

When target_files=ui_modified is passed in scoped_mode, audit_text_truncation_and_overflow and audit_orphaned_classes_and_styles accept all extensions in ui_modified rather than filtering to each invariant's unscoped extension set (e.g., valid CSS like 'background-position: center center;' in a modified .css file could match DUPLICATE_PHRASE_PATTERN).

observations.detail: git show main:... cross-check is skipped if local main ref is absent; acceptable since EXPECTED_ORIGINAL_WAITING_PARAGRAPH is already asserted verbatim against the worktree file.
